test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Mechanic Diesel) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following information is required to construct a rectangle?

options.text: Length of a side and area of ​​a rectangle
Only the length of the diagonal

solution:
The correct answer is __Length of two adjacent sides.__

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• A rectangle__ is a quadrilateral with opposite sides equal and all angles equal to 90 degrees.
 
• To construct a rectangle, the length of two adjacent sides is sufficient as the opposite sides are equal.
 
• The diagonal can be calculated using the Pythagoras theorem once the two adjacent sides are known.
 
• Knowing only one side or the area of the rectangle is not enough to construct it as the other dimension is required.
 
• Only the diagonal length is insufficient as the length and breadth of the rectangle can vary to give the same diagonal length.
